{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values: -1, 0, 999
sentinel_values = [-1, 0, 999]
sentinel_counts = {}
for val in sentinel_values:
    sentinel_counts[val] = sales_df['customer_age'].eq(val).sum()

# Examine the actual values in customer_age
age_values = sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index()

# Check for implausible ages (e.g., 0, 999, negative)
invalid_ages = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'].isin(sentinel_values)]

# Print results
sentinel_counts, age_values.head(10), invalid_ages.head()"}
